title: Unbelievable
text: My wife and I were the only two on this trip so it was like a private tour... But saying that, it was very interesting to find out about the life of an olive that goes to olive juice (oil). It was very formal and right through the heart of the processing plant. Then on to tasting and enjoying the aromas along with the spicy heat. My wife and I would gladly go again if we make it back to Granada!
author: Bill_D

title: Fun route.
text: A very fun route and very beautiful to see. Route to do in summer, we went in August and there was water up to our knees, so in winter, I don't know if it can be done.
author: mhblanco1
